description: Get the chain-brand leaderboard for one AI platform in one week: which hotel groups (Marriott, Accor, Hilton, IHG and the rest) get mentioned most, and across how many distinct properties. Use this when the user asks which hotel chains or brands dominate AI recommendations, how a specific group performs against its competitors in AI answers, or whether big brands beat independents. For individual properties use get_ai_hotel_visibility instead.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

week.description: Snapshot week as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent.

name: get_hotel_brand_leaderboard
